company: Arnik Design and Build Pty Ltd
title: Full time Civil Engineering Draftsperson
content_text: ArNik Design and Build Pty Ltd (family-owned design-and-build, Kew VIC) seeks full-time Civil Engineering Draftsperson for residential and commercial projects. Duties: prepare single line diagrams, tables, sketches, charts, plans and designs for civil works such as crossover, driveway, stormwater systems, roads; prepare preliminary designs in 2D using hand sketches, PDF editors or AutoCAD; prepare concise engineering drawings from sketches unassisted; comply with CAD Standards; place feature surveys onto drawings and understand site levels; complete STORM Reports; assist with printing and council follow-up; complete council and building permit checklists. Ideal candidate: at least 12 months post-qualification experience as a civil engineering draftsperson; at least a bachelor's degree in a related field; experience using Revit and AutoCAD; salary band $80k-$90k. Expiring in about 4 days from 4 Oct 2026 listing page. Apply via HIA advert or email resume (email redacted on public page).
apply_instructions: Apply via HIA job board Apply button, or email resume to the address shown on the advert (redacted on aggregator mirrors).
